task_completion.description: Create at least 4 new partition walls to separate the open plan building shell.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 2D floor plan or 3D view shows at least 4 new wall segments added to the original building shell to create internal divisions.

task_completion.description: Define at least 5 distinct named rooms reflecting aquarium zones (e.g., Ticketing, Main Exhibits, Touch Tank, Classroom, Gift Shop).
task_completion.visual_evidence: The floor plan shows at least 5 colored or labeled room areas with specific aquarium-related names visible in the room properties or labels.

task_completion.description: Furnish Exhibits and Retail areas with at least 10 shelving or display units.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 2D/3D view shows at least 10 furniture items resembling shelves, display cases, or racks placed within the designated exhibit or shop zones.

task_completion.description: Furnish Education and Lobby areas with at least 12 chairs and 4 desks or tables.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 2D/3D view shows a count of at least 12 chair icons and 4 table/desk icons placed in the classroom or lobby zones.

task_completion.description: Draw a continuous visitor flow path (polyline) with at least 4 distinct points and 3 text labels.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A visible line (polyline) with at least 4 vertices tracing a route through the building, accompanied by at least 3 text labels highlighting features.

task_completion.description: Save the project file when complete.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Save' icon is clicked, or a 'Save' dialog appears, or the window title reflects a saved state/filename.

integrity.description: The agent used the Sweet Home 3D GUI to perform the design tasks.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the furniture catalog, wall drawing tools, and room creation tools within the application window.

integrity.description: The agent did not use terminal commands to bypass the design process.
integrity.visual_evidence: The design progress is visible incrementally in the GUI screenshots rather than appearing instantly via script execution.

integrity.description: The layout is a genuine attempt at a visitor center, not a random placement of objects.
integrity.visual_evidence: The furniture and walls are organized logically into rooms that match the assigned labels (e.g., chairs in the classroom, shelves in the shop).

privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must use the starter file 'aquarium_shell_starter.sh3d'. Success requires: 4+ walls, 5+ named rooms (aquarium themes), 10+ shelves/displays in exhibits/retail, 12+ chairs and 4+ tables in education/lobby, a polyline with 4+ points for flow, and 3+ text labels. The pass threshold is 70/100.
